newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ING unit renews $1.0 bln CP programme.
newsitem.headline: ING unit renews $1.0 bln CP programme.

text.p: ING Groep NV said its ING Insurance unit had renewed its $1.0 billion euro commercial paper (ECP) programme and expanded the number of currencies in which it can borrow under the programme.
In addition to U.S. dollars and European currency units (ECUs), ING Insurance can now raise short-term funds in German marks, Dutch guilders, British pounds sterling and Japanese yen.
The programme was developed by ING Bank and Citibank. The dealers are Barclays de Zoete Wedd, NatWest Capital Markets and J.P. Morgan Securities.
ING said ING Insurance had a AA-/Aa2 credit rating and would use the programme for general funding purposes.
